entries.title: Mutual TLS (mTLS) and X.509 workload identity federation
entries.summary: OpenAI API正式支持双向TLS及X.509工作负载身份联合。

entries.title: Announced the deprecation of `whisper-1`, `gpt-4o-transcribe`, `gpt-4o-mini-transcribe`, and `gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize`.
entries.summary: 四款转录模型将于2027年2月26日停用，Assistants API已关闭。

entries.title: API customers can now select regional processing for an individual request
entries.summary: API客户现可为单次请求选择区域处理位置。

entries.title: GPT-5.6 Sol now costs $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens
entries.summary: GPT-5.6 Sol输入降价20%，输出降价33%。

entries.title: Released the Prompt Caching dashboard
entries.summary: 上线提示缓存仪表板，可查看命中率及各类令牌用量。

entries.title: Transparent backgrounds are now available in preview for `gpt-image-2` and `gpt-image-2-2026-04-21`
entries.summary: GPT Image 2在图像及Responses API中预览支持透明背景。

entries.title: Announced Ultrafast mode
entries.summary: GPT-5.6 Sol推出最高快14倍的Ultrafast限量预览模式。

entries.title: Daybreak now offers two access tiers for approved defenders: Daybreak Blue and Daybreak Red.
entries.summary: Daybreak为获批防御人员推出Blue和Red两种访问层级。

entries.title: Updated the **chat-latest** snapshot
entries.summary: chat-latest快照已更新，指向Plus和Pro可用的最新模型。

entries.title: Fast mode now supports long-context requests for GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-5.6 Terra, and GPT-5.6 Luna.
entries.summary: GPT-5.6三款模型的Fast模式现支持超过272K令牌长上下文。

entries.title: Customers can now filter and group data by API key in the Usage and Costs dashboards
entries.summary: 用量与成本仪表板现可按API密钥筛选和分组数据。

entries.title: Starting July 30, GPT-5.6 Luna costs 80% less, while GPT-5.6 Terra costs 20% less.
entries.summary: GPT-5.6 Luna降价80%，Terra降价20%，并推出Fast模式。
